facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.justification: MOC-2015-0063 was raised at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop on 16 July 2015 following 4 recorded events in the archive, including AF-2017-001, INC-2015-001 and INC-2019-003. The change request record covers 2 clauses across 3 controlled documents. The intent is to introduce a duty the documents in scope did not previously carry. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are MOC-2021-0155, PRO-MIN-003 and STD-MEQ-007.
